node.title: Re^3: help declaring variables within perl one-liner
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
One liners are bad enough; but I swear, "shelling-out" to actual Perl scripts from a Perl script is one of the most offensive things I can see in Perl code.

My opinion is actually the other way around: [doc://system], when used properly, is less bad than using qx//, because the latter almost always involves the shell and introduces quoting problems - though what I said above still stands, calling another perl is almost never necessary (the most common exception I make is during testing). See [id://1180578] and [id://1205217].
